Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
v_count pls_integer;
begin
 BEGIN
 select territory_short_name into :sponsors.territory_short_name 
 from valid_territories
 where territory_id = :sponsors.territory_id AND
 :local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, to_date(:local_date)+1) AND
 decode(chapter_id,'ALL',:global.chapter_id,chapter_id) = :GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID; --Decode added for IM 8335
 :sponsors.row_num := nvl(:ctrl_block_1.dummy,0) + 1;
 :ctrl_block_1.dummy := :sponsors.row_num;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then
 message('1');PAUSE;
 handle_error;
 END;

 Begin
 ---
 select count('x') into v_count from dual
 where exists (select null from SPONSORS S, ADDRESSES A
 WHERE s.SPONSOR_ID = :sponsors.sponsor_id 
 and decode(s.chapter_id,'ALL',:global.chapter_id,s.chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id --Decode added for IM 8335
 and a.address_id = s.address_id 
 and a.intl_addr_flag = 'Y');
 
 if v_count = 1 then
 
 SELECT a.mapsco, a.INTL_POSTAL_CODE
 into :sponsors.mapsco,
 :sponsors.zip 
 FROM SPONSORS S, ADDRESSES A
 WHERE s.SPONSOR_ID = :sponsors.sponsor_id 
 and decode(s.chapter_id,'ALL',:global.chapter_id,s.chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id --Decode added for IM 8335
 and a.address_id = s.address_id 
 and a.intl_addr_flag = 'Y' and rownum = 1;

 else
 
 select mapsco,city,zip into :sponsors.mapsco,
 :sponsors.city,
 :sponsors.zip 
 from sponsors s,addresses a, valid_city_state vc
 where
 s.address_id = a.address_id and decode(a.chapter_id,'ALL',:global.chapter_id,a.chapter_id) = :Global.chapter_id --Decode added for IM 8335
 and a.usps_id = vC.usps_id 
 and
 sponsor_id = :sponsors.sponsor_id and decode(s.chapter_id,'ALL',:global.chapter_id,s.chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id --Decode added for IM 8335
 and rownum = 1; 
 end if;
 
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then 
 message('2');PAUSE;
 handle_error;
 end;
 
 Begin

 if v_count = 1 then
 
 SELECT (a.intl_address_1 ||
 decode(a.intl_address_2, null, null,', '||a.intl_address_2) || 
 decode(a.intl_address_3, null, null,', '|| a.intl_address_3) || 
 decode(a.intl_address_4, null, null,', '|| a.intl_address_4)||', '||
 a.COUNTRY_NAME)
 into :ctrl_block_1.spon_addr
 FROM SPONSORS S, ADDRESSES A
 WHERE S.SPONSOR_ID = :sponsors.sponsor_id
 and a.address_id = s.address_id 
 and a.intl_addr_flag = 'Y' and rownum = 1;

 else
 
 select Rtrim(Street_name) || decode(address_1,null,' ',',')|| 
 Rtrim(Address_1) || decode(address_2,null,' ',',') ||
 Rtrim(Address_2) 
 into :ctrl_block_1.spon_addr
 from sponsors s,addresses a 
 where s.address_id = a.address_id
 and sponsor_id = :sponsors.sponsor_id and rownum=1;
 
 end if;
 
 Exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then 
 message('3');PAUSE;
 handle_error;
 End;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-UPDATE
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :ctrl_block_1.eff_date is not null then
 /*
 ** Update to Drives table
 */
 begin
 update drives
 set territory_id = :sponsors.territory_id
 where drive_id in ( select drive_id
 from drive_sponsors
 where sponsor_id = :sponsors.sponsor_id )
 and drive_date >= :ctrl_block_1.eff_date;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 /*
 ** Update to Temp Drives table
 */
 begin
 update temp_drives
 set territory_id = :sponsors.territory_id
 where tempdr_id in ( select tempdr_id
 from temp_drive_sponsors
 where sponsor_id = :sponsors.sponsor_id )
 and drive_date >= :ctrl_block_1.eff_date;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
end if;

BEGIN
 --global.program_version := '1.01.01';
 --global.program_version := '2.03.00';

 --:global.program_version := '05'; -- international address 4/5/11
 --:global.program_version := '06'; /* IM 5280 Julius 4/20/11*/ 
 --:global.program_version := '07'; -- IM# 5280 (Made ZIP field as text_item and also navigable)

RecordGroup.Name: RG_TERRITORY
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select territory_short_name,territory_id, territory_name from valid_territories where 
(territory_short_name like '%' || :ctrl_block_1.territory_short_name || '%'
or
 territory_name like '%' || :ctrl_block_1.territory_short_name || '%'
or
territory_id = :ctrl_block_1.territory_short_name )
and
:local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, to_date(:local_date)+1) and decode(chapter_id,'ALL',:global.chapter_id,chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id order by 1

RecordGroup.Name: RG_NEW
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select territory_short_name , territory_id , territory_name from valid_territories where territory_id != :ctrl_block_1.territory_id
and (
territory_short_name like '%' || :ctrl_block_1.new_territory || '%'
 or
territory_name like '%' || :ctrl_block_1.new_territory || '%'
 or
territory_id = :ctrl_block_1.new_territory)
and :local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, to_date(:local_date)+1) and decode(chapter_id,'ALL',:global.chapter_id,chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id order by 1

RecordGroup.Name: RG_EMPL

 user_class = 'RECRT'

Trigger.Name: ON-MESSAGE
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE 
 alert_button NUMBER; 
 lv_errtyp VARCHAR2(3) := MESSAGE_TYPE;
 lv_errcod NUMBER := MESSAGE_CODE;
 lv_errtxt VARCHAR2(80) := MESSAGE_TEXT;
BEGIN 
 IF lv_errcod = 41008 THEN 
 show_error('1180');
 
 ELSE 
 Message(lv_errtyp||'-'||to_char(lv_errcod)||': '||lv_errtxt);
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF; 
END;
